review_type: static adapter review plus native Windows original-asset probe
scope: CharacterVisual generic adapter animation binding, defaults, palette, placement, loops, ownership
correct_semantics: Skin palette multiplies joint world * inverse_bind * bind_shape; adapter uses resulting positions directly without a second instance transform.
Palette output remains authored scene coordinates; host placement and axis conversion belongs at draw time.
Player owns copied animation bytes, accessor storage remains alive inside Impl; model mesh/skin records and primitive streams are copied before local BRES bytes die.
Every Player stores a rest graph and resets unanimated properties on each sample. Optional caller-provided template is sampled before all Players load.
Time is milliseconds with clip start offset retained. Attack clip955 begins at266ms; current calculation includes this offset.
Palette positions and normals use same skin influences; normal directions exclude translation.
Reload builds and validates a candidate before publishing it; failed load preserves prior character.
Authoritative original asset identifiers are caller configuration; preview does not hardcode campaign model or class.
Arbitrary named clip bank supersedes convenience idle/walk/attack names. Unknown names and duplicate-bank reloads fail without changing current pose.
One-shot sampling clamps at actual clip end, including nonzero authored start; loop sampling wraps at original duration.
bugs_reported_and_resolved: Elapsed interval is reduced modulo clip duration before milliseconds conversion, avoiding finite-seconds multiplication overflow.
Duration subtraction now widens operands before subtracting.
Invalid CharacterPose values are rejected before selecting a player.
Moved-from accessors return empty values or restore an empty Impl rather than dereferencing null.
limitations: Native CPU animation/skinning probe passed; this does not prove WGL rendering, texture orientation, frame performance, or visual match.

Strict missing-target policy successfully bound selected Prince template/idle/walk/attack. Other shared clips containing omitted model bones still need explicit handling; existing full Prince bank pipeline uses MissingTargets::ignore.
Original Player samples only transform types1/5/10 and adapter rejects skipped channels. Other animation domains need dedicated support rather than silent omission.
Zero-weight skin records produce zero positions by original software-skin semantics; arbitrary asset coverage may require explicit rigid-vertex policy used by existing object renderer.
Direct primitive material ID matching may need instance symbol mapping for arbitrary future models.
